== Source, printing and text-state verification (Story 386) ==
The [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-world-championship-mark-walseth-ls-obi-wan-communing/ published Players Committee decklist] was compared with the [[Media:26Worlds Walseth LS Obi-Muning.txt|wiki-hosted XML download]] and the card articles linked in the table. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114035258/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2026-world-championship-mark-walseth-ls-obi-wan-communing.html Players Committee decklist]. The download's File page attributes the XML to the forum distribution; the original forum ZIP has not been independently byte-verified.
The download contains 60 constructed-card entries. Its SHA-256 is <code>1a5ccc5693d3910e0e280d536d93e74ede55fc1fbb8aabcb153f6cd44b409d73</code>; the download bytes were retained. The article lists 60 constructed cards and 29 outside-deck cards. Each outside-deck XML identity is counted separately; a card outside the deck is placed in its own card-type group when it is not a Defensive Shield.

=== Printing choices ===
* 1x [[Threepio With His Parts Showing (AI)]]: XML <nowiki>11_14</nowiki>. The published list says <nowiki>1x Threepio With His Parts Showing (AI)</nowiki>. The linked AI/ALT belongs to the same card family and its engine gameplay record matches the ordinary image after excluding image-identity fields.
